description: Check 1 to 20 drafts against every network’s rules in a single call. Answers allValid and a per-draft result (valid, errors, ask, choose) without stopping on the first failure. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

items.description: One to 20 drafts to validate in a single call.

id.description: A draft id from drafts_list or drafts_create.

version.description: The draft’s version as you last read it.

name: drafts_validate_batch
title: Check a batch of drafts
